senses.gloss: (v.סָרַק III) to paint; to paste (with red or yellow clay).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:42">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ</cite> top <he>דשָׁרְקָא אפה</he> who paints her face (on the Sabbath); <he>דש׳ מעזלה</he> who paints her yarn (to rub her face with it; v.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:13">Tosef. Sabb. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:13">X</cite>), 13, quot. s. v. <cite ref="O01667"><he>סָרָק</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Nedarim 90a:1">Ned. 90ᵃ</cite> top <he>שַׁרְקֵיה טינא וכ׳</he> he painted the man’s face with clay (to disguise him), and brought him &c.; (Tosaf.: he smeared clay over his garments).

<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:12">Bets. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>דמר שָׁרְקִין ליה תנורא וכ׳</he> that they smear (fill up the cracks of) the stove for you on the Holy Day.—Part. pass. <cite ref="U01984"><he>שְׁרִיקָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 31a">Ab. Zar. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ וחתימא</he> pasted with clay and sealed.
